messages:
leah: Thinking about thresholds table density. Proposal: a 'compact' mode toggle that uses stacked micro-rows with 1-line summaries and exposes an inline preview on hover. Pros: fits more rules on screen. Cons: hover-only previews are bad for keyboard/mobiles.
omar: Hover previews should have a persistent focus equivalent. Maybe on keyboard focus or tap they pin the preview.
felix: Copy nit: the preview header currently says 'Notify channels'  change to 'Notification targets' to align with routing docs. Also prefer 'Snooze' vs 'Mute' as we discussed earlier.
tara: Mobile behavior: collapsing into accordion that reveals full rule + 'Test notification' button. We should keep the test action visible without extra clicks.
a11y-bot: A11Y checklist: 1) ensure focusable previews, 2) avoid relying on hover alone, 3) ensure expand control has aria-expanded and an accessible label.
leah: Also debating whether to show token-cost estimate per rule (from Optimize). Could be useful but noisy. Maybe only show on hover/expand. What do you think?
omar: Cost could be useful when policies route to different model sizes (dedicated vs hosted). Show a small cost-per-alert number in the expanded view.
felix: UI weight: cost numbers should be caption style, muted color. If red-flag (cost > threshold) add a tiny badge 'High cost'.
tara: Regarding grouping, don't group rules if they have different recovery notifications (i.e. some teams want recovery emails). That's a subtle but important difference.
leah: Agree. Grouping rules must be conservative: only group when expression, channels, severity, and recovery actions match.
a11y-bot: Voiceover test note: Ensure screen reader announces grouping as 'Group of 2 alerts. Press enter to expand'.
leah: I'll update the mock to include compact toggle, pinned preview on focus, cost in expanded view, and 'Test notification' visible on mobile expand. Will share before Friday review.
